notes: Stories created for Mongo query size estimation with clear separation of contract, logic, integration, and tests.

BL-0.1.4-009-S1.title: Define Mongo Query Size Estimation Contract
BL-0.1.4-009-S1.description: Define a reusable schema and contract for estimating Mongo query size including inputs (filters, projections, limits) and outputs (estimated document count, byte size, and threshold flags).

BL-0.1.4-009-S2.title: Implement Query Size Estimation Logic
BL-0.1.4-009-S2.description: Build core logic to estimate Mongo query result size using heuristics (document size sampling, limit caps, and collection stats) and compute whether the query risks exceeding system thresholds (e.g., 500KB response cap, 100-doc limit).

BL-0.1.4-009-S3.title: Integrate Size Guard into GPTReader Query Execution
BL-0.1.4-009-S3.description: Integrate estimation logic into GPTReader so queries are pre-checked and either truncated, rejected, or safely limited before execution to enforce response caps and prevent oversized payloads.

BL-0.1.4-009-S4.title: Expose Query Size Warnings via API Response Metadata
BL-0.1.4-009-S4.description: Extend GPTReader responses to include metadata flags indicating when a query was truncated, estimated as large, or adjusted due to size constraints, enabling transparency and downstream handling.

BL-0.1.4-009-S5.title: Unit and Integration Tests for Query Size Estimation and Guardrails
BL-0.1.4-009-S5.description: Create tests validating estimation accuracy, enforcement of 100-document and 500KB limits, truncation behavior, and safe handling of edge cases (large collections, missing stats, complex filters).
